[[File:Peter W. Jones 2012.jpg|thumb|220px|Peter Jones (mathematician)]]
'''Peter Wilcox Jones''' (born 1952) is a mathematician at [[Yale University]], known for his work in [[harmonic analysis]] and [[fractal geometry]].  He received his Ph.D. at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] in 1978, under the supervision of [[John B. Garnett]].  He received the [[Salem Prize]] in 1981. He is an elected member of the [[United States National Academy of Sciences|U.S. National Academy of Sciences]] (2008),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nasonline.org/site/Dir?sid=1011&view=basic&pg=srch |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051025074536/http://www.nasonline.org/site/Dir?sid=1011&view=basic&pg=srch |url-status=dead |archive-date=October 25, 2005 |title=NAS Membership Directory |publisher=NAS|accessdate={{Format date|2012|11|12}}}}</ref> the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] (2008),<ref>{{cite web |url=http://kva.se/en/contact/Kontakt-sida/?personId=3499 |title=Kungliga Vetenskapsakademien |publisher=Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences |accessdate={{Format date|2012|11|12}} |archive-date=2020-03-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200312043213/https://kva.se/en/contact/Kontakt-sida/?personId=3499 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] (1998).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.yale.edu/1998/05/21/five-yale-scholars-elected-fellows-american-academy-arts-and-sciences |title=Five Yale Scholars Elected Fellows of American Academy of Arts and Sciences |date=21 May 1998 |publisher=Yale|accessdate={{Format date|2012|11|12}}}}</ref> He is not related to the mathematician [[Vaughan Jones]].
